answer: Cap new identities per network origin: each ASN and device-fingerprint cluster gets a small per-epoch quota, like one plume of smoke per chimney — a thousand accounts from one origin echo the same kernel of hardware and routing, so the quota chokes them at birth. A sybil farmer must then rent diverse residential networks and real devices for every fake, paying that cost again each epoch. Limit: shared NATs and VPNs can false-flag honest users behind one origin, and determined attackers can still buy diversity.
